FOREWORD

Indian Standard ( Part 2 ) was adopted by the Indian Institution on 7 March 1986, after the draft finalized by the Insulators and Accessories Sectional Committee had been by the Electrotechnical Division Council. clamping used with specified. kV rating

0.2 This standard ( Part 2 ) deals with the dimensions of arrangements for 72.5 kV and 123 kV rating bushings to be transformers. The materials for the parts have also been The dimensions of clamping arrangements for 12 kV to 36 bushings are covered in Part 1 of this standard.

0.3 The dimensions of porcelain parts and metal part fittings for transformer bushings for lightly polluted and heavily polluted atmospheres are covered in a series of standards under IS : 3347* and IS : 8603t, respectively. 0.4 In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 42538 - `Transformers, clamping arrangement for bushings', issued by Deutsches Normenausschuss. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with The number of significant places retained in the rounded IS : 2-1960:. off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. *Dimensions for porcelain transformer bushings. tDimensions for porcelain transformer bushings for use in heavily
